construction.exterior_source: cached_fixture_exterior: analytic total minus exact-density plasma image

current_target_provenance.construction: closed-form polynomial current density integrated over the exact traced separatrix supports, including first cell moments

current_receipt.construction: closed-form polynomial current density integrated over the exact traced separatrix supports, including first cell moments

trial_semantics: Every native nonlinear trial-map evaluation, including refused and duplicate evaluations; incumbent evaluations are labelled. GMRES basis vectors are linear algebra directions, not physical trial states.
collapse_definition: First physical candidate below half the seed core-cell count or half its absolute unscaled current; diagnostic threshold, not a production guard.

support_shrink.definition: negative Euclidean gradient of absolute unscaled current at seed, restricted to unshadowed state coordinates; lambda renormalization keeps scaled current fixed

negative_control.mutation: the same singular-direction analysis repeated with lambda held fixed at its seed value must change the projection of the accepted step onto the support-shrink direction; if the projection reading does not change, the degenerate-direction reading is not supported and the receipt says so
negative_control.interpretation: The accepted physical displacement and unscaled-current gradient are held fixed, so their geometric projection is invariant under changing lambda in the map. The separately measured singular subspaces may change; this declared control does not establish a causal degenerate-direction explanation.

postprocessing.first_promotion_derivation: same H200 allocation, scheduler step 1276502.1; first-promotion.log
postprocessing.assembly: JSON merge of first-promotion-directions.json after the main measurement finished
postprocessing.scheduler_qualification: Job and batch completed 0:0; main printed EXIT=0; supplemental step 1276502.1 completed 0:0. Scheduler also retains python3 step 1276502.0 CANCELLED 0:15 at batch teardown; this is not erased or equated with the successful job.
